failure_summary: A5a fails 5/5 deterministically because the render itself supplies only cNrM vocabulary for the two load-bearing squares - render_decision.link.text reads verbatim "let the opponent occupy c3r1 ... would have denied it at c3r1" and the offered alias roles read "the one at c3r1"/"the one at c2r1" (verified by calling buildReasonRenderModel+assembleGroundedPrompt on this row), so every run echoes raw squares into coach prose (OI-194) despite the prompt's own "Never write a raw square" line; secondary render defects: the decision board's Tactics list asserts "double threat ... at c2r1 (opp, window c2r1.c3r1.c4r1.c5r1)" although visualize_board 334 reports "Major threats: none" and the engine's own finalMovestring 33432 shows the opponent ENTERING at c3r1 (opponentPunishment.entryCell/completingCell say c2r1), which is what pushed runs 0 and 1 into the board-false claim that the opponent "grabs c2r1" to create the fork (A4), and no alias is offered for c6r1 even though opponentPunishment.cells/anchorCells list it, leaving "two winning squares at once" half-unlocatable (A7b).
notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3/A4/G2/G4/G5 graded on runs 0-1 only, null elsewhere; A5/A7 graded on all 5. A1/A2/A6 copied verbatim from the mechanical json (all pass, 5/5 keys present). A5a fail 5/5: runs 0-4 all print raw c3r1/c2r1 in mechanism prose. A5b: player===2 AND boardState==="opening" so the sub-rule applies, but the case is win_to_lose (solver on 334: col3 and col6 score +2, played col4 -18), so no run says the player is lost and every run gives a constructive frame - A5b passes; noting the rule's hold-the-line premise does not fit a position the second player actually WINS. A4 fail runs 0-1: 'you let them grab c2r1 and create a double threat' / 'let your opponent use c2r1 to create the four-in-a-row line ... and keep both winning squares alive' - board-false; visualize_board 33432 shows the fork is created by the opponent taking c3r1, after which the two gravity-top majors are col2 row1 and col6 row1. A7b fail runs 0,1,4: 'two winning squares at once' / 'both winning squares' with only c2r1 nameable - c6r1 appears in the internal-evidence JSON but has no zone handle, so the second square is unlocatable. A7c passes everywhere: the fork pivot c3r1 is named in all 5 runs via the offered [zone:opp-key-square] (no *-fork-pivot handle exists, none needed). G5 fail (runs 0-1 graded, render is identical for all 5 so the defect is deterministic): decision-board Tactics entry is not board-true on the decision board. G4 pass: c3r1 lies on render_decision.finalMovestring 33432 and c2r1 is board-verified as a gravity-top major on that same line's terminal position - no alternate PV used. G7 pass: mechanical membership passed, annotationRepairs empty in all 5 runs, line-words sit on the line handle and square-words on square handles in every run; noting the models emitted spec-form tags ([zone:c3r1], [zone:windows:...]) rather than the listed handle names, which production accepted without repair. OI-183 not implicated: every required handle was emitted, so production's retry would not have fired.
